Question: a 12 meter long wire is cut into two pieces . if the longer piece is then used to form a perimeter of a square , what is the probability that the area of the square will be more than 4 if the original wire was cut at an arbitrary point ?

Options: 
A. 1 / 6
B. 2 / 3
C. 3 / 10
D. 1 / 3
E. 2 / 5

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
